assets.caption: Figure 5: Sketch of Assembled Joint to be Torqued
assets.description: Engineering cross-section drawing of an assembled flanged bolted joint ready for torquing. Callouts identify: Heavy Hex Nut (top and bottom), Flange, Bolt, Lubricant (Loctite C5-A or as directed by Reliability Engineer), Two Hardened Washers (F436 Type 1 Circular), Gasket at centre, thread-count requirement (minimum one thread showing after final bolt up, maximum four threads), and instruction to place torque wrench on nut with two washers.
